payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP recurrence arr[k] = 2*arr[k-1] - arr[k-3] computes number of non-empty zebroid subsequences in length-n zebroid sequence.
payload.rationale: Solution is a classical DP counting problem: counting valid subsequences via a linear recurrence with 1D state. The dp_counting_combinatorics subtype exactly captures this combinatorial counting DP.
